description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RLI Insurance Company is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to design, develop, modify, and maintain software applications of limited complexity. The role includes coding, testing, troubleshooting, supporting implementations, and collaborating with technical colleagues.
Associate .NET Software Engineer analyzing, designing, developing, and implementing software applications; assisting with enhancements and post-implementation support

Responsibilities:
• Performs analysis, design, development, and implementation of software applications of limited complexity
• Assists with post implementation support and system enhancements
• Gathers and compiles information regarding technological processes and systems
• Coordinates with internal contacts to perform specific project tasks or resolve technical issues
• Monitors product/process quality in relation to individual contributions
• Researches new technology solutions and best practices
• Assists in special projects and other duties as needed

Requirements:
• Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field
• 0+ years of relevant experience
• equivalent level of education and experience
• Proficiency in .NET programming, including C# and related development technologies
• Ability to effectively use AI-assisted development tools, such as Codex or similar coding assistants, to support software development, troubleshooting, testing, and code improvement
• Ability to review, understand, and validate AI-generated code and recommendations for accuracy, security, maintainability, and alignment with development standards
• Ability to leverage AI-assisted development tools to identify defects, troubleshoot technical issues, refactor code, develop tests, and improve code quality
• General understanding of Relational Database Systems/Data Management
• Knowledge of Programming including Web Technologies
• Analytical, problem solving, and organizational skills
• Ability to understand and utilize a variety of the field's concepts, practices and procedures
• Ability to communicate findings and recommendations to internal and external contacts on IT matters
• Ability to work well independently or within a team
• Ability to use software to develop and analyze IT data and applications
• Acquaintance with  software and automated testing
